what_happened: Research found the two territory-edge dependency tasks (430 feed_undeclared_implement_paths_into_file_scope, 446 close_the_plan_to_file_scope_reconciliation_gap) had already landed and were archived, and re-derived their actual landed shape from their own summaries rather than trusting the dispatch's forward-looking description. This directly determined the ruling: the general feedback mechanism mechanizes recovery but does not eliminate the follow-up-commit cost, so ruling (3) (subsumption) is not supported.

The dispatch's Option (2) (pre-commit requirement surfacing) targets a different failure mode than this record's LIVE SYMPTOM: an equivalent check (sync-manifest-scripts.sh --check / check-extension-docs.sh Rule Q, wired into verify-deploy.sh gate 3) already exists but runs post-redeploy, after the phase commit this record is about. The dispatch description did not mention this existing lint, which research surfaced via grep over check-extension-docs.sh and verify-deploy.sh.

Dispatch description cites git-commit-phase.sh's is_contained() at 'around lines 272-305'; re-derivation at plan time found it at lines 720-752 (normalization loop 730-732), with 272-305 now header prose about repository classification. Behavioural claim (trailing-slash defect closed) confirmed; only the line citation was stale.

The research report had already re-derived the three existing file_scope_arr splices, the sync-manifest-scripts.sh MATCHING rule, and the landed shapes of tasks 430/446/484, so plan decomposition needed only confirmation reads rather than fresh investigation. Suite-selection claims for both non-final phases were produced by running suite_selection_select directly rather than guessed.

Plan's Non-Goals forbade touching git-commit-scoped.sh's own, separate V10 containment guard (Site 3), on the premise that a Site-2-only (git-commit-phase.sh file_scope_arr) splice would be sufficient. Testing (Case 45/48 fixtures) proved this false: Site 2's widened file_scope_arr admits the extension manifest.json into kept_files_touched/stage_paths, which is handed to git-commit-scoped.sh as a positive pathspec; git-commit-scoped.sh's OWN independent V10 containment_scope_arr resolution (re-reading specs/state.json raw, with no knowledge of Site 2's new splice) still drops it, producing a Site-2-vs-Site-3 mismatch that trips the post-commit completeness check (exit 6) -- turning the PRE-EXISTING silent, recoverable drop-and-warn into a LOUD completeness-check failure, a regression rather than a fix. All three pre-existing splices (own-task-directory, engine-written-state, derived-output-prefix) are already independently mirrored at BOTH Site 2 and Site 3; the new splice must be too. Resolving by mirroring the identical pure-string derivation into git-commit-scoped.sh's own containment_scope_arr resolution (same placement convention: inside the non-empty guard, after the derived-output-prefix widening, before is_contained_v10), deviating from the plan's stated Non-Goal with this record as the evidence trail.
